title: Tentacruel Gets Older and Loses Tentacles

direction.premise: Tentacruel normally has 80 poisonous tentacles, but older individuals have fewer.
direction.audiencePromise: See why Tentacruel's famous 80-tentacle image may change with age.
direction.openLoop: If Tentacruel gets older, what happens to its signature tentacles?
direction.payoff: Tentacruel's tentacle count is not fixed forever. Older individuals have fewer.
direction.engagementQuestion: Better with 80 tentacles, or more mysterious with fewer?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange discovery. Keep the pace quick, warm, and slightly playful. Stress older, fewer, and 80. Pause briefly before the final choice.

scenes.headline: OLDER MEANS FEWER
scenes.narration: Tentacruel gets older and starts losing its tentacles.
scenes.caption: AGE CHANGES THE COUNT

scenes.headline: 80 POISONOUS TENTACLES
scenes.narration: Normally, Tentacruel has all 80 of its poisonous tentacles.
scenes.caption: THE CLASSIC TENTACRUEL

scenes.headline: A POISONOUS NET
scenes.narration: Those tentacles stretch freely, forming a poisonous net around prey.
scenes.caption: STRETCH. WRAP. WEAKEN.

scenes.headline: OLDER MEANS FEWER
scenes.narration: But the Pokédex says older Tentacruel have fewer tentacles.
scenes.caption: THE COUNT DROPS WITH AGE

scenes.headline: BUT BATTLE SHOWS ALL 80
scenes.narration: Yet several entries still describe all 80 extending in battle.
scenes.caption: SEVERAL ENTRIES SAY ALL 80

scenes.headline: THE COUNT ISN'T FOREVER
scenes.narration: Age changes its arsenal. Better with 80, or fewer?
scenes.caption: 80 TENTACLES OR FEWER?
